meta.title: Secretary profile management - states and artifacts

cards.title: Definition Artifacts + Ownership
items: Maintained path: docs/profiles/<id>/
Contents: README, SOUL, workflow HTML when needed
Owner: Secretary with hermes-fleet-admin and documentation-writer
Exact model/effort and skill/plugin/MCP/automation manifest are approved targets, not assumptions
Target: Secretary itself or another profile. Operation: create / update / maintain / delete. Same workflow, not separate planning or skill-writing work types.

cards.title: Executor Plan Contract
items: Secretary uses superpowers:writing-plans: docs/superpowers/plans/<task>.md, created or updated before handing write tasks to Executor.
Includes files/profile paths, inputs, authorized delta, tools/skills, dependencies
Acceptance checks, rollback, status/evidence pointers
Bootstrap uses current approved runner (OpenCode); Executor stays patch-only until approved application contract
Executor reads both the approved definition and approved plan. Incomplete readiness pauses handoff; it does not authorize unrestricted fallback.
A live-configuration plan names the target Hermes home and exact settings; application is allowed only under an explicitly approved access contract. No invented keys or secrets in tracked docs.

cards.title: Capability Loading / Activation
items: Skills: select, discover, load, verify in fresh session
Plugins: install/enable/configure approved targets; test lifecycle hooks
MCP: profile-scoped connection, user auth, verify tool calls, secrets outside docs
Automation: inspect trigger/runner/side effects/recovery; run authorized test; memory bank health
Verify identity/project context and only the approved capability set. A listed skill, enabled plugin or declared MCP connection is not proof of successful runtime loading.

cards.title: Status / Evidence
items: Desired definition != saved runtime != observed operation
Reports/receipts retained in owning task/bundle
State is conceptual lifecycle of one request, not a live control panel
Delete requires destructive confirmation, dependency checks, recoverable backup
Coordinator is optional authorized source-information support, not another executor.
No runtime setup by this diagram. Executor is still a draft; model and provider stay task/runtime-selected.
Definition-only approval stops at Docs Only. Failed checks produce Rework and an updated plan before retry, not a Done claim.

cards.title: Transition guards
items: defined -> planned: Create or update the executable plan before Executor handoff.
planned -> executing: requires approved plan, verified Executor readiness, authorized task scope
executing -> verifying: Patch-only tasks verify patches; live setup requires an explicitly approved application contract and supported configuration tools.
executor_missing -> planned: Complete Executor docs first, then approved bootstrap and actual readiness tests with the current runner.
